original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH
filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
d1_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
d2_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-01' AND '2002-01-30'
),
filtered_ca AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
),
filtered_ws AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_warehouse_sk
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
warehouse_store AS (
    SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk
    FROM warehouse w
    JOIN store s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
),
core_join AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_current_cdemo_sk,
        c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_item fi
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN d1_filtered d1
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_ws ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
       AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN d2_filtered d2
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
       AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
    JOIN warehouse_store wst
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = wst.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
       AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
       AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
       AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN filtered_ca ca
        ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
demo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c_current_cdemo_sk,
        c_current_hdemo_sk,
        count(*) AS cnt
    FROM core_join
    GROUP BY c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    SUM(da.cnt) AS cnt
FROM demo_agg da
JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON da.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON da.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_date_d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
    AND i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_quantity
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item i ON ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
),
filtered_web_sales AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_warehouse_sk
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
),
filtered_customer AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  FROM customer
  JOIN filtered_customer_address ca ON c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filtered_store_sales ss
JOIN filtered_web_sales ws
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  AND ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
JOIN filtered_date_d1 d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
JOIN filtered_customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN inventory inv
  ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
  AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Men')       and i_manager_id IN (9, 24, 27, 41, 59, 66, 78, 80, 83, 100)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('AL', 'MI', 'MS', 'OH', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 8 AND 28     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
    item i
JOIN
    store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN
    web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 8 AND 28
JOIN
    date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
        AND d1.d_year = 2001
JOIN
    date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
        AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
JOIN
    customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN
    customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
        AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MI', 'MS', 'OH', 'TX')
JOIN
    customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN
    household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN
    inventory inv ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
        AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
JOIN
    warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN
    store s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
WHERE
    i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Men')
    AND i.i_manager_id IN (9, 24, 27, 41, 59, 66, 78, 80, 83, 100)
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
    cnt

rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
    sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(SR_STORE_CREDIT) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM store_returns, date_dim
  WHERE sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND d_year = 2000
    AND sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 107 AND 166
  GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg_return AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_store_sk,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_return_threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store_avg_return sar ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sar.ctr_store_sk
JOIN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('MO', 'NC', 'PA')) s
  ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_customer_id, c_current_cdemo_sk FROM customer 
      WHERE c_birth_month = 5 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1962) c
  ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics 
      WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'W') 
        AND cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Unknown') 
        AND cd_gender = 'F') cd
  ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_return_threshold
  AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 17 AND 20
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100

    AVG(ss_ext_wholesale_cost),

JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001

    (cd_marital_status = 'S'

     AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00

)

    (ca_country = 'United States'
     AND ca_state IN ('MS', 'NY', 'VA')
     AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)

    (ca_country = 'United States'

WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
branched AS (
    -- Demo Branch 1: marital=U, education=College, dep_count=3, price 100-150
    SELECT ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_ext_sales_price, ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_filtered df ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'U'
        AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
        AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
      AND (
          (ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )

    UNION ALL

    -- Demo Branch 2: marital=W, education=2 yr Degree, dep_count=1, price 50-100
    SELECT ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_ext_sales_price, ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_filtered df ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND cd.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
        AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
      AND (
          (ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )

    UNION ALL

    -- Demo Branch 3: marital=S, education=College, dep_count=1, price 150-200
    SELECT ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_ext_sales_price, ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_filtered df ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'S'
        AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
        AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
        AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
      AND (
          (ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )
)
SELECT
    min(ss_quantity),
    min(ss_ext_sales_price),
    min(ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
    min(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM branched;

WITH target_week AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5
),
target_week_ly AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk ss_item_sk
  FROM item,
       (SELECT iss.i_brand_id brand_id, iss.i_class_id class_id, iss.i_category_id category_id
        FROM store_sales, item iss, date_dim d1
        WHERE ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
          AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
          AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
          AND iss.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
          AND iss.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
          AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
        INTERSECT
        SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
        FROM catalog_sales, item ics, date_dim d2
        WHERE cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
          AND cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
          AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
          AND ics.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
          AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
          AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
        INTERSECT
        SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
        FROM web_sales, item iws, date_dim d3
        WHERE ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
          AND ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
          AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
          AND iws.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
          AND iws.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
          AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) x
  WHERE i_brand_id = brand_id
    AND i_class_id = class_id
    AND i_category_id = category_id
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_sales) / NULLIF(SUM(total_count), 0) average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) total_sales, COUNT(*) total_count
    FROM store_sales, date_dim
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price), COUNT(*)
    FROM catalog_sales, date_dim
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price), COUNT(*)
    FROM web_sales, date_dim
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) x
)
SELECT this_year.channel ty_channel,
       this_year.i_brand_id ty_brand,
       this_year.i_class_id ty_class,
       this_year.i_category_id ty_category,
       this_year.sales ty_sales,
       this_year.number_sales ty_number_sales,
       last_year.channel ly_channel,
       last_year.i_brand_id ly_brand,
       last_year.i_class_id ly_class,
       last_year.i_category_id ly_category,
       last_year.sales ly_sales,
       last_year.number_sales ly_number_sales
FROM (
  SELECT 'store' channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id,
         SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) sales, COUNT(*) number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN cross_items ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = cross_items.ss_item_sk
  JOIN target_week ON date_dim.d_week_seq = target_week.d_week_seq
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) this_year
JOIN (
  SELECT 'store' channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id,
         SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) sales, COUNT(*) number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN cross_items ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = cross_items.ss_item_sk
  JOIN target_week_ly ON date_dim.d_week_seq = target_week_ly.d_week_seq
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) last_year
ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY this_year.channel, this_year.i_brand_id, this_year.i_class_id, this_year.i_category_id
LIMIT 100;

cross_items AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id

    SELECT DISTINCT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id

    JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
      AND iws.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND iws.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23

WITH store_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT iss.i_brand_id, iss.i_class_id, iss.i_category_id
  FROM store_sales
  INNER JOIN item iss ON ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
    AND iss.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
    AND iss.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
  INNER JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
catalog_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
  FROM catalog_sales
  INNER JOIN item ics ON cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
    AND ics.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
    AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
web_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
  FROM web_sales
  INNER JOIN item iws ON ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
    AND iws.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
    AND iws.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
  INNER JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM item i
  INNER JOIN store_items si ON i.i_brand_id = si.i_brand_id
    AND i.i_class_id = si.i_class_id
    AND i.i_category_id = si.i_category_id
  INNER JOIN catalog_items ci ON si.i_brand_id = ci.i_brand_id
    AND si.i_class_id = ci.i_class_id
    AND si.i_category_id = ci.i_category_id
  INNER JOIN web_items wi ON ci.i_brand_id = wi.i_brand_id
    AND ci.i_class_id = wi.i_class_id
    AND ci.i_category_id = wi.i_category_id
  WHERE i.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity, cs_list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity, ws_list_price
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43

),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,

  INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND i.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    AND d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9)
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)

last_year AS (

    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,

    AND d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9)
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)

SELECT

INNER JOIN last_year ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id

store_sales被扫描两次（this_year和last_year），两次扫描的过滤条件基本相同（ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43，i_category IN ('Children','Men','Women')，i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 and 58），仅d_week_seq的子查询条件不同（d_year=1999 vs d_year=1998）。可将两个子查询合并为一个，通过条件区分this_year和last_year的数据，避免对store_sales进行两次独立全表扫描。

WITH filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk

  WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'College'

filtered_d AS (

  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_ca AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Jewelry'
),
filtered_c AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_birth_year, c_current_addr_sk
  FROM customer
  WHERE c_birth_month = 5
),
filtered_cs AS (
  SELECT cs_sold_date_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk,
         cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_coupon_amt, cs_sales_price, cs_net_profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 84 AND 89
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       ca_country,
       ca_state,
       ca_county,
       avg(CAST(cs_quantity AS decimal(12,2))) agg1,
       avg(CAST(cs_list_price AS decimal(12,2))) agg2,
       avg(CAST(cs_coupon_amt AS decimal(12,2))) agg3,
       avg(CAST(cs_sales_price AS decimal(12,2))) agg4,
       avg(CAST(cs_net_profit AS decimal(12,2))) agg5,
       avg(CAST(c_birth_year AS decimal(12,2))) agg6
FROM filtered_cs
JOIN filtered_d ON filtered_cs.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_d.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_item ON filtered_cs.cs_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk
JOIN filtered_cd ON filtered_cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = filtered_cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN filtered_c ON filtered_cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = filtered_c.c_customer_sk
JOIN filtered_ca ON filtered_c.c_current_addr_sk = filtered_ca.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id

WITH d1_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy = 8 AND d_year = 2001
),
d2_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND d_year = 2001
),
d3_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND d_year = 2001
),
ss_sr AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.ss_item_sk,
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    ss.ss_net_profit,
    sr.sr_net_loss,
    sr.sr_customer_sk,
    sr.sr_item_sk
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN d1_filtered d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
                       AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
                       AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  JOIN d2_filtered d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.ss_store_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr.sr_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr.sr_item_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  i.i_item_id,
  i.i_item_desc,
  s.s_store_id,
  s.s_store_name,
  SUM(ss_sr.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
  SUM(ss_sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM ss_sr
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON ss_sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
                      AND ss_sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN d3_filtered d3 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ss_sr.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store s ON ss_sr.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100

rewritten_query:
SELECT
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name,
  MIN(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
  MIN(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
  MIN(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      ss_sold_date_sk,
      ss_item_sk,
      ss_customer_sk,
      ss_store_sk,
      ss_ticket_number,
      ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ss_store_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ss
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2002
  ) AS d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_item_desc
    FROM item
  ) AS i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_id, s_store_name
    FROM store
  ) AS s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      sr_customer_sk,
      sr_item_sk,
      sr_ticket_number,
      sr_returned_date_sk,
      sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns
    WHERE sr_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) AS sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d_year = 2002
  ) AS d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      cs_bill_customer_sk,
      cs_item_sk,
      cs_sold_date_sk,
      cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) AS cs ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND d_year = 2002
  ) AS d3 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
GROUP BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name
ORDER BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name
LIMIT 100

    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip,
    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) AS "30 days",
    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) AS "31-60 days",

    SUM(1) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) AS ">120 days"
FROM
    store_sales
JOIN
    store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
        AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
        AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk

JOIN
    store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
GROUP BY
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip
ORDER BY
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip
LIMIT 100;

with base_month as (
  select d_month_seq
  from date_dim
  where d_year = 1999 and d_moy = 7
  limit 1
),
my_customers as (
  select distinct c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  from (
    select c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    from catalog_sales
    join item on cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and i_category = 'Men' and i_class = 'accessories'
    join date_dim on cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_moy = 7 and d_year = 1999
    join customer on c_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk and c_birth_year between 1943 and 1956
    where cs_wholesale_cost between 44 and 74
    union all
    select c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    from web_sales
    join item on ws_item_sk = i_item_sk and i_category = 'Men' and i_class = 'accessories'
    join date_dim on ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_moy = 7 and d_year = 1999
    join customer on c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk and c_birth_year between 1943 and 1956
    where ws_wholesale_cost between 44 and 74
  ) combined
),
my_revenue as (
  select c_customer_sk,
         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as revenue
  from my_customers
  join store_sales on c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and ss_wholesale_cost between 44 and 74
  join customer_address on c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  join store on ca_county = s_county and ca_state = s_state and s_state in ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NC','NM','OH','OR','TX','VA')
  join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between (select d_month_seq+1 from base_month) and (select d_month_seq+3 from base_month)
  group by c_customer_sk
),
segments as (
  select cast((revenue/50) as int) as segment
  from my_revenue
)
select segment, count(*) as num_customers, segment*50 as segment_base
from segments
group by segment
order by segment, num_customers
limit 100

WITH date_month_seq AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 6
),
my_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  FROM (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN item
      ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
      AND i_category = 'Sports'
      AND i_class = 'camping'
    JOIN date_dim
      ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_moy = 6
      AND d_year = 2001
    JOIN customer
      ON c_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk
      AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1932 AND 1945
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item
      ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
      AND i_category = 'Sports'
      AND i_class = 'camping'
    JOIN date_dim
      ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_moy = 6
      AND d_year = 2001
    JOIN customer
      ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
      AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1932 AND 1945
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
  ) t
),
my_revenue AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk,
         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM my_customers,
       store_sales,
       customer_address,
       store,
       date_dim
  WHERE c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    AND ca_county = s_county
    AND ca_state = s_state
    AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
    AND s_state IN ('IA','MD','MO','MS','NE','NY','OK','TN','TX','VA')
    AND d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT d_month_seq + 1 FROM date_month_seq)
                        AND (SELECT d_month_seq + 3 FROM date_month_seq)
  GROUP BY c_customer_sk
),
segments AS (
  SELECT cast((revenue / 50) AS int) AS segment
  FROM my_revenue
)
SELECT segment,
       count(*) AS num_customers,
       segment * 50 AS segment_base
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

valid_dates as (

  where d_month_seq = (select d_month_seq from target_month)
),
filtered_items as (
  select i_item_sk, i_item_id
  from item
  where i_manager_id between 28 and 57
),
filtered_customers as (
  select c_customer_sk, c_birth_year
  from customer
  where c_birth_year between 1938 and 1944
),
ss_items as (
  select i.i_item_id as item_id,

         sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) as ss_item_rev
  from store_sales ss
  join valid_dates d on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  join filtered_items i on ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  join filtered_customers c on ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  where ss.ss_list_price between 269 and 298
  group by i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
cs_items as (
  select i.i_item_id as item_id,
         c.c_birth_year as birth_year,
         sum(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) as cs_item_rev
  from catalog_sales cs
  join valid_dates d on cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  join filtered_items i on cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  join filtered_customers c on cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  where cs.cs_list_price between 269 and 298
  group by i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
),
ws_items as (
  select i.i_item_id as item_id,
         c.c_birth_year as birth_year,
         sum(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) as ws_item_rev
  from web_sales ws
  join valid_dates d on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  join filtered_items i on ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  join filtered_customers c on ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  where ws.ws_list_price between 269 and 298
  group by i.i_item_id, c.c_birth_year
)
select ss_items.item_id,
       ss_items.birth_year,
       ss_item_rev,
       ss_item_rev/((ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3) * 100 as ss_dev,
       cs_item_rev,
       cs_item_rev/((ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3) * 100 as cs_dev,
       ws_item_rev,
       ws_item_rev/((ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3) * 100 as ws_dev,
       (ss_item_rev+cs_item_rev+ws_item_rev)/3 as average
from ss_items
join cs_items on ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id and ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year
join ws_items on ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id and ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year
where ss_item_rev between 0.9 * cs_item_rev and 1.1 * cs_item_rev
  and ss_item_rev between 0.9 * ws_item_rev and 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  and cs_item_rev between 0.9 * ss_item_rev and 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  and cs_item_rev between 0.9 * ws_item_rev and 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  and ws_item_rev between 0.9 * ss_item_rev and 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  and ws_item_rev between 0.9 * cs_item_rev and 1.1 * cs_item_rev
order by item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev
limit 100

  GROUP BY d_week_seq, ss_store_sk

  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6

LEFT OUTER JOIN (

  FROM promotion

GROUP BY i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq

    SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,
           cs.cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt,
           cs.cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0) AS sales_amt

      ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.68 AND 0.88
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)) d
      ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, cr_return_quantity, cr_return_amount, cr_reason_sk FROM catalog_returns) cr
      ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44)
    UNION
    SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,

    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Women') i
      ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.68 AND 0.88
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)) d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_return_quantity, sr_return_amt, sr_reason_sk FROM store_returns) sr
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44)

    SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,

      ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.68 AND 0.88
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)) d

    LEFT JOIN (SELECT wr_order_number, wr_item_sk, wr_return_quantity, wr_return_amt, wr_reason_sk FROM web_returns) wr
      ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44)
  ) sales_detail
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)
SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year,
       curr_yr.d_year AS year,
       curr_yr.i_brand_id,
       curr_yr.i_class_id,
       curr_yr.i_category_id,
       curr_yr.i_manufact_id,
       prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
       curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM all_sales curr_yr, all_sales prev_yr
WHERE curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id
  AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id
  AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id
  AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id
  AND curr_yr.d_year = 2002
  AND prev_yr.d_year = 2001
  AND prev_yr.sales_cnt > 0
  AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) / CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) < 0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_returns AS (
  SELECT

    cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 1998
  JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT

    ca_state AS ctr_state,

  FROM filtered_returns
  GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
state_avg_return AS (
  SELECT

rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d
  WHERE d.d_month_seq IN (
    SELECT d_month_seq 
    FROM date_dim 
    WHERE d_date IN ('1999-03-22','1999-05-27','1999-08-04','1999-11-10')
  )
),
sr_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk 
    AND i.i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 3 AND 12
  JOIN filtered_dates fd ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  WHERE sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 264 AND 293
    AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
cr_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND i.i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 3 AND 12
  JOIN filtered_dates fd ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_return_amount / cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 264 AND 293
    AND cr.cr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
wr_items AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    AND i.i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Women')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 3 AND 12
  JOIN filtered_dates fd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  WHERE wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 264 AND 293
    AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (3, 4, 26, 40, 52)
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT sr_items.item_id,
       sr_item_qty,
       sr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,
       cr_item_qty,
       cr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev,
       wr_item_qty,
       wr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev,
       (sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 AS average
FROM sr_items
JOIN cr_items ON sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id
JOIN wr_items ON sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id
ORDER BY sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty
LIMIT 100

         wr.wr_refunded_cash, wr.wr_fee, wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk, wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk, wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk,
         cd1.cd_demo_sk as cd1_demo_sk, cd1.cd_marital_status as cd1_marital_status, cd1.cd_education_status as cd1_education_status,
         cd2.cd_demo_sk as cd2_demo_sk, cd2.cd_marital_status as cd2_marital_status, cd2.cd_education_status as cd2_education_status,
         ca.ca_state
  from web_sales ws
  join web_returns wr on ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk and ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
  join web_page wp on ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  join (select d_date_sk from date_dim where d_year = 1998) d on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  join customer_demographics cd1 on cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk

  join (select ca_address_sk, ca_state from customer_address where ca_country = 'United States') ca on ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk

     and cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' and cd2.cd_education_status = 'College'
     and ws.ws_sales_price between 50.00 and 100.00)
    or
    (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D'
     and cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' and cd2.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'

  and (

    (ca.ca_state in ('MT', 'NM', 'OR') and ws.ws_net_profit between 150 and 300)
    or
    (ca.ca_state in ('GA', 'IL', 'OH') and ws.ws_net_profit between 50 and 250)

original_query: select     sum(ws_ext_discount_amt)  as "Excess Discount Amount" from     web_sales    ,item    ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 394 and 593 or i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) and i_item_sk = ws_item_sk and d_date between '2002-02-11' and         cast('2002-02-11' as date) + interval '90' day and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88 and ws_ext_discount_amt      > (          SELECT             1.3 * avg(ws_ext_discount_amt)          FROM             web_sales            ,date_dim          WHERE               ws_item_sk = i_item_sk           and d_date between '2002-02-11' and                              cast('2002-02-11' as date) + interval '90' day           and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk           and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88           and ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 85 * 0.01 AND 100 * 0.01   ) order by sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH ws_filtered AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_ext_discount_amt, ws_wholesale_cost, ws_sales_price, ws_list_price
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND '2002-05-12'
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88
),
item_threshold AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS threshold
  FROM ws_filtered
  WHERE ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.85 AND 1.00
  GROUP BY ws_item_sk
)
SELECT SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM ws_filtered ws
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN item_threshold t ON t.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
WHERE (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 394 AND 593 OR i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports'))
  AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > t.threshold

WITH filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1999
    AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'W'
    AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    AND cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_item1 AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music')
    AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_item2 AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 77 AND 96
    AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_s1 AS (
  SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 250
    AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),

  SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 250
    AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
)

FROM filtered_item1 AS item1
INNER JOIN filtered_item2 AS item2
  ON item1.i_item_sk < item2.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_s1 AS s1
  ON s1.ss_item_sk = item1.i_item_sk

original_query: select  c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, count(*) as cnt FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90' day) AND ca_state in ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK') AND d1.d_year = 2000 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND hd_buy_potential = '0-500' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 38 * 0.01 AND 58 * 0.01 GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name ORDER BY cnt ;
rewritten_query:
WITH d1_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),
item_filtered AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports') AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
ca_filtered AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK') AND ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
),
hd_filtered AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20
    AND hd_buy_potential = '0-500'
    AND hd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_sales_price, ss_list_price
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.38 AND 0.58
    AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
),
store_returns_filtered AS (
  SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_returns
  WHERE sr_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
    AND sr_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM store_sales_filtered ss
JOIN store_returns_filtered sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
JOIN web_sales_filtered ws ON ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN d1_filtered d1 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90' day) AND d2.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN item_filtered i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND c.c_current_addr_sk IS NOT NULL AND c.c_current_hdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN ca_filtered ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN hd_filtered hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt
